what: GPU time per process from IOAccelerator's AGXDeviceUserClient accumulatedGPUTime, sampled every 10 s (scratchpad gputime-log.py), 16:15 to 19:56 UTC on 2026-11-27, covering the matrix's and the runners' work. 'com.apple.WebKit' is every WebKit GPU process, ours (the WKWebView harnesses, the Mac apps) and any other app's.
note: Other apps are summed, not named. No other app used more than 10.6% of the GPU's time in any 10-s window. WindowServer drew the operator's display throughout (up to 16.2%).
